courses.title: 有機中介層製作
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入有機中介層 RDL、回流與機械順應性；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine organic-interposer rdl, returns and mechanical compliance. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。有機中介層不是單一材料或通用製程；公開 CoWoS-R 案例僅示範架構，尺寸與可靠度資料不得外推全部供應商。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Organic interposers are not one material or universal process; public CoWoS-R examples illustrate architecture, not universal geometry or reliability.

stages.title: 架構與層疊
stages.description: 本階段處理架構與層疊：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address architecture and stack-up through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 劃分晶粒與中介層
steps.objective: 建立「劃分晶粒與中介層」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for partition dies and interposer: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.
steps.check: 交付「劃分晶粒與中介層」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for partition dies and interposer, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 劃分晶粒與中介層：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Partition dies and interposer: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「劃分晶粒與中介層」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the partition dies and interposer model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫出晶粒、RDL、C4 及基板的層次。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw die, RDL, C4 and substrate levels. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：RDL 線距夠小就保證高速訊號完整性。本步先檢查「劃分晶粒與中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到中介層把高密度晶粒互連轉接到較大尺度封裝，需定義兩端焊墊。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Fine RDL spacing guarantees high-speed integrity. First check whether evidence for partition dies and interposer actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An interposer translates dense die connections to package scale; both pad interfaces need definition.
steps.check: 交付「劃分晶粒與中介層」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for partition dies and interposer: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.title: 選擇介電材料

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for select dielectric materials: Permittivity, loss, moisture uptake and CTE are distinct variables.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。建立電性與機械性能雙表。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Build separate electrical and mechanical property tables. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：建立電性與機械性能雙表。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for select dielectric materials actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Permittivity, loss, moisture uptake and CTE are distinct variables.
steps.check: 交付「選擇介電材料」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

steps.title: 估算銅線電阻

steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。重算 1.7 Ω 範例並將厚度加倍。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Recalculate 1.7 Ω and double thickness. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For hypothetical copper length 5 mm, width 10 μm, thickness 5 μm and ρ=1.7×10⁻⁸ Ωm, R=1.7 Ω; at 0.1 A DC drop is 0.17 V. Heating, contacts and AC effects are excluded.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.7 Ω and double thickness. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：有機材料柔軟所以沒有熱應力。本步先檢查「估算銅線電阻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到窄長 RDL 可有顯著 DC 壓降，即使晶粒間距看似很短。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Organic compliance eliminates all thermal stress. First check whether evidence for estimate copper resistance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Long narrow RDL can create appreciable DC drop despite short die spacing.
steps.check: 交付「估算銅線電阻」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 玻璃核心封裝基板
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入玻璃核心平整度、TGV 與脆裂風險；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine glass-core flatness, tgvs and brittle-fracture risk. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。公開測試載具展示不能等同所有玻璃核心方案已量產；材料組成、TGV 幾何與電性需個別驗證。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. A public test-vehicle demonstration does not establish production status for every glass-core solution; composition, TGV geometry and electrical behavior require validation.

courses.title: ABF 增層封裝基板
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入ABF 介電增層、微孔、銅附著與高頻損耗；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine abf build-up dielectric, microvias, copper adhesion and rf loss. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。ABF 是材料系列商標，不是一種固定通用配方；固化、粗化及製程條件需依供應商版本與專業設備規範。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. ABF is a branded material family, not one universal recipe; cure, roughening and process conditions require vendor-version and equipment specifications.

粗化越強，高頻性能一定越好
電容取決於厚度及介電常數，局部薄區可能增加耦合。

More roughening always improves RF performance

steps.title: 估算介電電容：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Estimate dielectric capacitance: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「估算介電電容」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the estimate dielectric capacitance model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction:
沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。重算 1.55 pF 與厚度容差。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。

假設平行板面積 1 mm²、間距 20 μm、εr=3.5，C=ε0εrA/d≈1.55 pF；介電厚度 ±10% 對 C 產生約相反方向 10% 一階變化，邊緣場未計。
steps.instructionEn:
Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Recalculate 1.55 pF with thickness tolerance. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

For area 1 mm², spacing 20 μm and εr=3.5, C≈1.55 pF. Thickness ±10% produces approximately opposite ±10% first-order capacitance change, excluding fringing.

steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.55 pF with thickness tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: More roughening always improves RF performance. First check whether evidence for estimate dielectric capacitance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Capacitance depends on thickness and permittivity; thin regions can increase coupling.

steps.title: 交付基板製造證據：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Deliver substrate evidence: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「交付基板製造證據」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the deliver substrate evidence model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。列出因材料換版必須重驗的項目。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. List checks required after a material revision. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：列出因材料換版必須重驗的項目。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List checks required after a material revision. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：粗化越強，高頻性能一定越好。本步先檢查「交付基板製造證據」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到材料批次、微孔良率與層疊模型需能互相追溯。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: More roughening always improves RF performance. First check whether evidence for deliver substrate evidence actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Material lot, via yield and stack-up model need traceability.
steps.check: 交付「交付基板製造證據」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for deliver substrate evidence: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

courses.title: 嵌入式互連橋整合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入嵌入式矽橋局部細密互連與封裝邊界；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine embedded silicon-bridge fine interconnects and package boundaries. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。本課以公開 EMIB 架構說明局部桥接；不同世代的供電、TSV 及互連能力須看原始資料，不能混稱所有橋接方案相同。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Public EMIB architecture illustrates local bridges; power, TSV and interconnect capabilities vary by generation and must not be conflated.

stages.title: 局部橋接架構
stages.description: 本階段處理局部橋接架構：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address local bridge architecture through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 比較局部與全面中介層
steps.objective: 建立「比較局部與全面中介層」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for compare local and full interposers: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫兩晶粒間的橋及其餘有機基板。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw a bridge between two dies and the surrounding substrate. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：矽橋等於覆蓋整包的矽中介層。本步先檢查「比較局部與全面中介層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到局部橋只在需要高密度連線處配置矽互連。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A silicon bridge equals a full-package silicon interposer. First check whether evidence for compare local and full interposers actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A local bridge places silicon routing only where dense links are needed.
steps.check: 交付「比較局部與全面中介層」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for compare local and full interposers, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 分配晶粒邊緣頻寬
steps.objective: 建立「分配晶粒邊緣頻寬」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：可用邊緣長與焊墊配置限制資料通道，不只看矽面積。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for allocate shoreline bandwidth: Available edge length and pad layout limit lanes, not only silicon area.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。驗算 80 個接點的幾何例。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設晶粒邊緣長 4 mm、單列有效接點間距 50 μm，幾何上限為 80 個接點；若保留 20% 給接地與備援，剩 64 個資料接點。這不是任何 EMIB 產品規格。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check the 80-site geometric example. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For a hypothetical 4 mm edge and 50 μm single-row effective pitch, the geometric limit is 80 sites; reserving 20% for ground/spares leaves 64 data sites. This is not an EMIB specification.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算 80 個接點的幾何例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

If not, revisit the physical constraint: Available edge length and pad layout limit lanes, not only silicon area.
steps.check: 交付「分配晶粒邊緣頻寬」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 小晶片互連實體層
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入晶粒間 PHY 通道、時序、訓練及量測；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine die-to-die phy channels, timing, training and measurement. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。UCIe 是含多層的規範體系；本文教學算例不代表任何版次的強制速率、編碼或時序限制，互通性須依指定版次測試。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. UCIe spans multiple layers; examples are not mandated rates, coding or timing limits of any version. Interoperability needs version-specific compliance testing.

knowledge.text: 假設 64 條資料線、每線 16 Gb/s、有效負載效率 80%，有效單向頻寬為 64×16×0.8/8=102.4 GB/s。線上速率不是應用有效吞吐。 UCIe 是含多層的規範體系；本文教學算例不代表任何版次的強制速率、編碼或時序限制，互通性須依指定版次測試。
knowledge.textEn: For 64 data lanes at 16 Gb/s and 80% payload efficiency, useful one-way bandwidth is 102.4 GB/s. Line rate is not application throughput. UCIe spans multiple layers; examples are not mandated rates, coding or timing limits of any version. Interoperability needs version-specific compliance testing.

courses.title: 高頻寬記憶體堆疊整合
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入HBM DRAM 堆疊、TSV、底部邏輯及熱路；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine hbm dram stacks, tsvs, base logic and thermal paths. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。不同 HBM 世代的通道、基底晶粒與接合方法不同；本課不把供應商某一 MR-MUF 案例當所有 HBM 的共同配方。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. HBM generations differ in channels, base dies and bonding; a vendor MR-MUF example is not a universal HBM recipe.

stages.descriptionEn: Address memory-stack role through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「安排堆疊測試」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the plan stack testing model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。對每種失效指定可檢出的測試。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Assign a detecting test to each failure type. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：對每種失效指定可檢出的測試。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Assign a detecting test to each failure type. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：所有 DRAM 層的熱邊界完全相同。本步先檢查「安排堆疊測試」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到記憶體功能、TSV 連通與電源完整性需要互補測試。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Every DRAM layer has identical thermal boundaries. First check whether evidence for plan stack testing actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Memory function, TSV continuity and PI need complementary tests.
steps.check: 交付「安排堆疊測試」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for plan stack testing: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.textEn: Assign a detecting test to each failure type. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

options: 對每種失效指定可檢出的測試。

所有 DRAM 層的熱邊界完全相同

stages.title: 系統整合
stages.description: 本階段處理系統整合：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address system integration through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 驗算複合良率
steps.objective: 建立「驗算複合良率」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：多個獨立良率相乘會降低總良率，相關缺陷會改變模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for calculate compound yield: Multiplying independent yields lowers total yield; correlations alter the model.
steps.instruction:

Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

courses.title: 3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入3D 邏輯堆疊熱阻、熱點重疊及工作負載；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine 3d logic thermal resistance, hotspot overlap and workloads. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。熱阻網路是降階近似；3D 堆疊中的空間耦合、溫度相依漏電與瞬態工作負載需要校準模型。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Thermal networks are reduced approximations; spatial coupling, temperature-dependent leakage and transient workloads require calibration.

courses.title: 封裝供電完整性設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入封裝 PDN 的 IR drop、Ldi/dt、反共振及量測；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine package pdn ir drop, ldi/dt, antiresonance and metrology. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。目標阻抗是設計工具，不代表每個頻率都可用同一標量完整描述多埠供電網路；要匹配負載頻譜及量測參考面。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Target impedance is a design tool, not a complete scalar description of every multiport PDN frequency; match load spectra and reference planes.

steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「建立負載頻譜」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the build load spectrum model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較平滑與突發兩種負載。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare smooth and burst loads. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較平滑與突發兩種負載。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare smooth and burst loads. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只量電源端就能代表每個晶粒焊墊。本步先檢查「建立負載頻譜」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到相同平均電流可能有不同 di/dt 與頻譜，供電壓力也不同。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Supply-terminal measurement represents every die pad. First check whether evidence for build load spectrum actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Equal average currents can differ in slew and spectrum.
steps.check: 交付「建立負載頻譜」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for build load spectrum: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.titleEn: Build load spectrum: mechanism
knowledge.text: 相同平均電流可能有不同 di/dt 與頻譜，供電壓力也不同。
knowledge.textEn: Equal average currents can differ in slew and spectrum.

knowledge.title: 建立負載頻譜：證據與判讀
knowledge.titleEn: Build load spectrum: evidence and interpretation
knowledge.text: 比較平滑與突發兩種負載。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Compare smooth and burst loads. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「建立負載頻譜：反證與驗收」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for build load spectrum: challenge and acceptance?
options: 只量電源端就能代表每個晶粒焊墊
比較平滑與突發兩種負載。
DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格
optionsEn: Supply-terminal measurement represents every die pad
Compare smooth and burst loads.
Passing DC drop guarantees all transients
quiz.explanation: 相同平均電流可能有不同 di/dt 與頻譜，供電壓力也不同。 比較平滑與突發兩種負載。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal average currents can differ in slew and spectrum. Compare smooth and burst loads.

steps.title: 設定目標阻抗
steps.objective: 建立「設定目標阻抗」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：ΔV/ΔI 是初始頻域目標，必須指定對應擾動範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for set impedance target: ΔV/ΔI is an initial frequency target with a defined disturbance range.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。驗算 3 mΩ 例並列頻帶。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設允許動態壓降 30 mV、負載變化 10 A，初步 Ztarget=3 mΩ；若 DC 路徑 R=2 mΩ、電流 20 A，另有 40 mV DC 壓降，不能從同一預算重複支出。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check the 3 mΩ example and define the band. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For 30 mV dynamic droop and 10 A load change, initial Ztarget=3 mΩ. A 2 mΩ DC path at 20 A adds 40 mV DC drop and cannot reuse the same budget.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算 3 mΩ 例並列頻帶。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Check the 3 mΩ example and define the band. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「設定目標阻抗」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到ΔV/ΔI 是初始頻域目標，必須指定對應擾動範圍。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for set impedance target actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ΔV/ΔI is an initial frequency target with a defined disturbance range.
steps.check: 交付「設定目標阻抗」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for set impedance target, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

Target impedance is a design tool, not a complete scalar description of every multiport PDN frequency; match load spectra and reference planes.

stages.title: 供回路與去耦
stages.description: 本階段處理供回路與去耦：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address supply returns and decoupling through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 追蹤電源與地
steps.objective: 建立「追蹤電源與地」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：回流與電源同樣影響供電回路，地彈跳也消耗電壓裕量。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for trace supply and ground: Returns affect the loop as much as supply; ground bounce consumes margin.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫完整閉合回路和參考電壓。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw the closed loop and voltage reference. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫完整閉合回路和參考電壓。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「追蹤電源與地」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到回流與電源同樣影響供電回路，地彈跳也消耗電壓裕量。所指出的物理限制。

steps.check: 交付「追蹤電源與地」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。

courses.title: 封裝訊號完整性設計
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入封裝 SI 的阻抗、串音、偏斜與眼圖；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine package si impedance, crosstalk, skew and eye diagrams. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。眼圖需指定資料模式、等化、負載及量測参考面；板級公式是初步模型，封裝非均勻轉接需場解和去嵌入。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Eyes need defined patterns, equalization, loads and reference planes; board formulas are initial models, while package transitions need fields and de-embedding.

knowledge.text: 比較冷熱及寬窄線角點。 記錄原始觀察和推論之間的區別。
knowledge.textEn: Compare cold/hot and wide/narrow trace corners. Keep raw observations distinct from inference.

quiz.question: 在「測試製程與溫度角點」中，哪個處理方式或主張有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach or claim is physically justified for test process/temperature corners?
options: 介電、電阻及幾何散布改變最差通道。
只要 DC 連通就沒有訊號完整性問題
差分訊號不需要回流路徑
optionsEn: Dielectric, resistance and geometry spread change the worst channel.
DC continuity eliminates signal-integrity problems
Differential signals require no return path
quiz.explanation: 介電、電阻及幾何散布改變最差通道。 比較冷熱及寬窄線角點。
quiz.explanationEn: Dielectric, resistance and geometry spread change the worst channel. Compare cold/hot and wide/narrow trace corners.

steps.title: 測試製程與溫度角點：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Test process/temperature corners: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以獨立證據檢驗「測試製程與溫度角點」的模型，辨別真實效應與量測或模型誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the test process/temperature corners model with independent evidence and separate physical effects from measurement or model error.
steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。比較冷熱及寬窄線角點。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Compare cold/hot and wide/narrow trace corners. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：比較冷熱及寬窄線角點。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Compare cold/hot and wide/narrow trace corners. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：差分訊號不需要回流路徑。本步先檢查「測試製程與溫度角點」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到介電、電阻及幾何散布改變最差通道。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Differential signals require no return path. First check whether evidence for test process/temperature corners actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Dielectric, resistance and geometry spread change the worst channel.
steps.check: 交付「測試製程與溫度角點」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for test process/temperature corners: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

steps.objective: 建立「提交通道接受範圍」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：需同時报告資料率、等化、負載、眼圖及誤差假設。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for deliver channel acceptance range: Report rate, equalization, load, eye and error assumptions together.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。列出尚未包含的封裝轉接。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List package transitions not yet included. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：列出尚未包含的封裝轉接。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List package transitions not yet included. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只要 DC 連通就沒有訊號完整性問題。本步先檢查「提交通道接受範圍」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到需同時报告資料率、等化、負載、眼圖及誤差假設。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: DC continuity eliminates signal-integrity problems. First check whether evidence for deliver channel acceptance range actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Report rate, equalization, load, eye and error assumptions together.
steps.check: 交付「提交通道接受範圍」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for deliver channel acceptance range, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

courses.title: 封裝射頻遮蔽
courses.summary: 以四階段、24 步深入RF 屏蔽導電連續性、孔縫與近場耦合；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
courses.summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine rf shield continuity, apertures and near-field coupling. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
courses.scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。遠場平面波屏蔽公式不直接涵蓋封裝近場磁耦合；材料厚度只是因素之一，孔縫、接地及共振需實測。
courses.scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Far-field plane-wave shielding formulas do not directly cover package near-field magnetic coupling; thickness is only one factor alongside seams, grounding and resonance.

stages.title: 場源與耦合
stages.description: 本階段處理場源與耦合：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address sources and coupling through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義干擾源和受害者
steps.objective: 建立「定義干擾源和受害者」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define source and victim: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫源、耦合路徑及受害回路。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：畫源、耦合路徑及受害回路。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：金屬厚度足夠就可忽略接縫。本步先檢查「定義干擾源和受害者」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Sufficient metal thickness makes seams irrelevant. First check whether evidence for define source and victim actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.
steps.check: 交付「定義干擾源和受害者」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define source and victim, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.
